probe: What subject format does a repository created after 2026-07-15 mint with no opt-in, and does job_workflow_ref carry @id suffixes when sub does?

repository.immutable_subject_opt_in: none -- no setting was changed after creation; the format below is the default for a repository created on this date

request: curl -sS -H "Authorization: bearer ${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN}" "${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL}&audience=subvectors-probe" ; the .value JWT's payload segment was base64url-decoded and printed with jq -c -S ; the signed token was never printed or stored
verdict: sub is minted in the immutable format (owner@id/repo@id) with no opt-in. job_workflow_ref, workflow_ref and repository carry no ids: the immutable format changes sub only. The consumer-side match of these strings is not observed here; only what GitHub mints is.
